name: smwmusic-chrono-trigger-psx-scattering-blossoms
title: Chrono Trigger (PSX) - Scattering Blossoms
description:
An extra track that was composed by Tsuyoshi Sekito for the Playstation port of said game. It's listened on the music box of the extras menus.
Due to the original song having much more than 8 channels, I decided to separate it into two versions, one for the Pianos and other for the Choir ones. If you want to use the Choirs, change the Choir_Version define to 1.
Also, because this song is very heavy in sample usage, I had to downsample the Choir, Piano and the String Ensemble samples to make it compatible with most of vanilla SFX.
Anyway, an unoptimized version is also included.

Requested by BootaNoBijuu/Neo Bonobi.
